local Players = game:GetService("Players")

	button.Position = position

	button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

	button.TextScaled = true

	button.AutoButtonColor = true
	button.Active = true
	button.Parent = mainFrame

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = button

	return button

local infiniteJumpButton = createButton(
	"InfiniteJumpButton",
	"INFINITE JUMP",
	UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 42)
)

local noClipButton = createButton(
	"NoClipButton",
	"NO CLIP",
	UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 88)
)

-- DRAGGING
local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startingPosition = nil

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startingPosition = mainFrame.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then

		local difference = input.Position - dragStart

		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startingPosition.X.Scale,
			startingPosition.X.Offset + difference.X,
			startingPosition.Y.Scale,
			startingPosition.Y.Offset + difference.Y
		)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

		dragging = false
	end
end)

-- INFINITE JUMP
infiniteJumpButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	infiniteJumpEnabled = not infiniteJumpEnabled

	if infiniteJumpEnabled then
		infiniteJumpButton.Text = "INFINITE JUMP [ON]"
		infiniteJumpButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 170, 70)
	else
		infiniteJumpButton.Text = "INFINITE JUMP [OFF]"
		infiniteJumpButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
	end
end)

	if not infiniteJumpEnabled then
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
	end
end)

-- NO CLIP
local savedCollisionStates = {}

local function saveCollisionStates(character)
	savedCollisionStates = {}

	for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			savedCollisionStates[object] = object.CanCollide
		end
	end
end

local function restoreCollisionStates()
	for object, collisionState in pairs(savedCollisionStates) do
		if object and object.Parent then
			object.CanCollide = collisionState
		end
	end

	savedCollisionStates = {}
end

noClipButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	noClipEnabled = not noClipEnabled

	local character = player.Character

	if noClipEnabled then
		noClipButton.Text = "NO CLIP [ON]"
		noClipButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 170, 70)

		if character then
			saveCollisionStates(character)
		end
	else
		noClipButton.Text = "NO CLIP [OFF]"
		noClipButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)

		restoreCollisionStates()
	end
end)

-- NO CLIP LOOP
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	if not noClipEnabled then
		return
	end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			object.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end)

-- RESPAWN SUPPORT
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	savedCollisionStates = {}

	if noClipEnabled then
		task.wait(0.5)
		saveCollisionStates(character)
	end
end)

local function wrapGroup(group)
    local obj = {}
    function obj:CreateSection(text)
        group:AddDivider()
        group:AddLabel(text)
    end
    function obj:CreateDivider()
        return group:AddDivider()
    end
    function obj:CreateToggle(c)
        return group:AddToggle(c.Flag or c.Name, {Text=c.Name, Default=c.CurrentValue or false, Callback=c.Callback})
    end
    function obj:CreateDropdown(c)
        local default = c.CurrentOption
        if c.MultipleOptions then
            if type(default) ~= "table" then default = {} end
        else
            if type(default) == "table" then default = default[1] end
            if default == nil or default == "" then default = c.Options and c.Options[1] end
        end
        local callback = c.Callback
        local dropdown = group:AddDropdown(c.Flag or c.Name, {Text=c.Name, Default=default, Values=c.Options or {}, Multi=c.MultipleOptions or false, Callback=function(value)

                local selected = {}
                for name,state in pairs(value) do
                    if state then selected[#selected+1] = name end
                end
                if callback then return callback(selected) end
                return
            end
            if callback then return callback(value) end
        end})
        function dropdown:Refresh(values)
            return self:SetValues(values or {})
        end
        return dropdown
    end

        return group:AddButton({Text=c.Name, DoubleClick=false, Func=c.Callback})

- Unknown Item Filter — choose whether to collect items missing from the registry.

- Separate Chest Range — customize chest searching independently.
- Collect Nearest Now — manually trigger collection of the closest eligible pickup.

MULTI CAST & WEAPONS

- Multi Cast — activate multiple selected weapons together.

- Cast On Click — activate your selected weapons with a single click.
- Auto Cast — repeat casting at an adjustable interval.
- Keep Weapons Equipped — automatically re-equip selected weapons.
- Refresh Weapon List — update available choices after inventory changes.

ESP & VISIBILITY

- Drop ESP — highlight items with rarity-based colors.

- Chest ESP — highlight chests independently of item rarity filters.
- Player ESP — distinguish teammates from other players.
- Customize ESP range, distance labels, and maximum highlights.

- Fullbright, No Fog, and options to remove darkness, blur, and flashbang overlays.

- Auto Buff — trigger Quick Buff at a configurable interval.
- Auto Sanity Potion — consume an available potion when sanity reaches your threshold.

MOVEMENT & TRAVEL

- Client-side No Stun and No Ragdoll options.
- Custom field of view and maximum camera zoom.

ALERTS & UTILITIES

- Boss spawn and defeat notifications.
- Rare Drop Alerts with adjustable rarity and detection range.
- Build the Item Registry for rarity filtering and rare-drop alerts.
- Export item rarities and monster drop information.
